facts.fact: The CGIAR tool series says the WaPOR-based Water Use Tool is used by the WaPOR Digital Unit at the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development, hosted by its Department of Statistics and Strategies, and uses 20 m WaPOR satellite data to compute dekadal irrigation water use and map irrigated and rainfed parcels, with a dashboard for the Mitidja West scheme.

systems.owner: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development (DSS)

DZA.note: INRAA chairs the task force but the document states no digital policy research.
